headline: Approved Dodge Street conduit permit, $8,500 marine grant, and license renewals; held wage-study funding and wildlife-feeding rules in committee.
summary: The council heard updates on bicycle and pedestrian safety work and the city's trash and recycling contract, then held public hearings on a National Grid underground conduit petition and a $241,250 wage-study funding transfer for Public Services employees. It approved the National Grid petition, a marine fisheries grant, and several license items, while holding the wage transfer, several appointments, and proposed animal-feeding rules in committee.
